messages:
anika: Heads-up — planning to bring up rwd-v6.0-int4-canary tonight 02:00 UTC. small slice (2%) on chat routes. main checks: MRR, hallucination, p95 latency, token cost. :rocket:

matt: sgtm. are we doing kv warmup and prefix caching for the canary?

anika: yes — kv warmup on, prefix cache enabled. warmup plan: 50k sample tokens spread over first 10m, batch_size=8.

sasha: add the long-doc probe suite (3k docs) + high-rerank slice. also include the safety prompt set from last regression run.

carla: what are the auto-fallback thresholds? need them explicit for the runbook.

anika: auto-fallback triggers (any single condition sustained for 10m):
- MRR drop >= 1.5% absolute vs baseline
- hallucination rate delta >= 0.7% absolute
- latency p95 > baseline + 40ms
- error rate (5xx) > baseline * 3
- token cost per 1k > baseline * 1.25

matt: can we make MRR drop require significance over 2 slices (longdoc & shortanswer) to avoid flukes?

anika: yes — primary rule: MRR drop must be observed in at least two of three marker slices (longdoc, shortanswer, rerank) OR a single-slice hallucination spike >=1%

sasha: logging for rollback: capture sample IDs, model outputs, and nearest-neighbor embeddings at time of failures. keep samples for 30d.

anika: added. also will enable verbose eval hooks for first 30m.

carla: please attach the rollout config so SRE can pre-approve.

anika: pasted config below (simplified):
```
routes: ["/chat", "/chat/priority"]
canary_fraction: 0.02
auto_fallback:
  mrr_drop_pct: 1.5
  hallucination_delta_pct: 0.7
  latency_ms_delta: 40
  sustained_secs: 600
kv_warmup_tokens: 50000
probe_suites: ["longdoc_v2", "rerank_heavy", "safety_v3"]
metrics_emit_interval: 30s
```

matt: nice. also add an explicit cooloff: if fallback triggers, block re-promote for 24h unless manual override.

anika: done. cooloff 24h added.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy of rwd-v6.0-int4-canary at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z to eng-canary-pool-03.

carla: who owns the post-run analysis? need a quick audit in #incidents if anything trips.

sasha: i'll run the automated eval notebook and post summary to #eng-ml + #incidents within 45m of the canary end.

matt: let's also enable shadow compare to v5.4-nf4 for 1h to surface any semantic drift before full traffic.

anika: shadow compare enabled for first 60m.

carla: ack. one last ask — add a sample-size guard: do not trigger auto-fallback unless at least 1k requests in the rolling 10m window. avoids noisy metrics during low traffic.

anika: added sample-size >= 1000 constraint to auto-fallback conditions.

sasha: all set from eval side. will surface noteworthy diffs: top-10 hallucination examples, latency tail histogram, token-cost delta.

anika: thanks everyone. ping me here if you see anything odd during the bring-up. :eyes:
